entries.complaint: The glossary lists 'fire flow', 'static pressure (fire flow)', and 'available fire flow' with empty preferred_translation, noting a native fire-protection engineer's settled term should be preferred if one exists. I have no access to a Myanmar fire-protection engineer, so I reused the suite's own existing phrase 'မီးငြိမ်းသတ်ရေးစီးနှုန်း' (already shipped in lpn_ex_elm_street_desc) across the whole lpn_ff_* group, and coined 'ဟိုက်ဒရင့်' (transliteration) for 'hydrant' since no Burmese water-utility hydrant term is established elsewhere in the file. These are reasonable engineering-register choices but are unverified against actual Myanmar fire-code usage.
readings: Use the suite's existing calque 'မီးငြိမ်းသတ်ရေးစီးနှုန်း' and the transliteration 'ဟိုက်ဒရင့်' (chosen)
Leave a loanword/English term in place pending native fire-protection review
